question: Which of the following minerals is NOT found in rivers (alluvial placers) and on the coast, especially beaches (beach placers)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bauxite.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The main minerals and metals associated with placer deposits are gold, cassiterite (tin), platinum, diamonds, magnetite, and some gemstones.
 
• The two most important kinds of placers are stream (alluvial) and beach placers.
 
 
• Hence Bauxite is the correct answer.
 
 
 
• Beach placers are formed in sand and gravel deposited along the edge of large bodies of water and are typically found where streams or rivers flow into a large body of water.
 
• Materials gather as beach placers by continuous wave action and currents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bauxite is a sedimentary rock with a relatively high aluminium content.
 
• It is the world's main source of aluminium and gallium.
 
• Bauxite is a naturally happen, heterogeneous material composed primarily of one or more aluminium hydroxide minerals, plus various mixtures of silica, iron oxide, titania, aluminosilicate, and other impurities in minor or trace amounts.
 
• The main uses of bauxite are multipurpose covering metallurgy, chemical industries, as raw material in building and road aggregates.
